With several installations now completing multi-year demonstrations this technology is fully commercially demonstrated. Modularization was the key engineering development that enabled us to scale down material costs, increase quality, hit our overall project cost targets, and dramatically decrease installation time since the technology comes pre-assembled in modular packages to site.
